rows.label: Pass defense
rows.tip: Rated on every play: EPA allowed per dropback, this season so far (counts 38% now) blended with last season. Higher = softer; rank 1 = toughest of 32. In 2023–25 ESPN’s projection for RBs moved 3.4% per sd of softer pass defense (range +2.1% to +4.9%), so a bigger role has more to move: +0.5 pts per sd on his 13.6 (range +0.3 to +0.7). After ESPN’s number the same rating explained +0.2 pts per sd (range −0.2 to +0.6) for the position: nothing usable. A defense’s rating does predict the next game’s offense EPA (slope 0.57, range 0.31 to 0.87), which is why ESPN already uses it.

After ESPN’s number the same rating explained −0.1 pts per sd (range −0.5 to +0.4) for the position: nothing usable. A defense’s rating does predict the next game’s offense EPA (slope 0.57, range 0.31 to 0.87), which is why ESPN already uses it.
